concepts.def: Branching diagram with probabilities and payoffs; calculates expected monetary value; aids choice under risk.
Quantifying private and external costs and benefits; net present value rule.
Strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, threats; Albert Humphrey at Stanford 1960s-70s.
Lewin 1947 maps driving and restraining forces; useful for change initiatives.
BCG growth-share matrix 1968 by Bruce Henderson; stars, cash cows, question marks, dogs.
Mapping plausible futures to test strategy; Shell adoption credited to Pierre Wack 1971.
